description: This PHP source file defines classes and parser logic for processing VTQL (a custom query language) statements, particularly focusing on parsing SELECT statements, and generating corresponding SQL queries within a CRM web services component.

classes.name: VTQL_ParseryyToken
classes.description: Represents a lexical token with string and metadata, supporting array access to its metadata.

classes.name: VTQL_ParseryyStackEntry
classes.description: Encapsulates a parser stack element including state number, major token, and minor token data.

classes.name: VTQL_Parser
classes.description: Implements a parser for VTQL syntax, capable of parsing SELECT statements, managing parser state, and constructing SQL queries.

methods.name: buildSelectStmt
methods.description: Constructs a SQL SELECT statement based on parsed VTQL query components.

methods.name: getTables
methods.description: Retrieves the list of involved tables based on the query's columns and metadata.

methods.name: getReferenceValue
methods.description: Extracts reference ID components from a value string.

methods.name: getOwner
methods.description: Retrieves owner ID components from a value string.

methods.name: getErrorMsg
methods.description: Returns any error messages generated during parsing.

methods.name: getQuery
methods.description: Returns the generated SQL query string after parsing.

methods.name: getObjectMetaData
methods.description: Returns metadata associated with the parsed object.
